description: This file defines the PdfCryptFilter class, which represents a cryptographic filter used within PDF security handling. It provides methods to initialize, configure encryption algorithms (such as RC4 and AES), and handle encryption/decryption processes for PDF document streams, adhering to different PDF security revisions and standards.

classes.name: PdfCryptFilter
classes.description: Represents a crypt filter dictionary used in PDF security, managing encryption methods and processing data streams with RC4 or AES encryption according to PDF specifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the crypt filter with a parent security handler and configures document version requirement.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToNone
methods.description: Configures the crypt filter to handle encryption as 'none', effectively bypassing encryption.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToRC4ForV4
methods.description: Configures the crypt filter to use RC4 encryption with a specified key length for PDF version 1.5 (encryption V4).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToAESForV4
methods.description: Configures the crypt filter to use AES encryption with a 128-bit key for PDF version 1.6 (encryption V4).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToAESForV5
methods.description: Configures the crypt filter to use AES encryption with a 256-bit key for PDF version 2.0 (encryption V5).

methods.name: PrepareForProcessing
methods.description: Prepares the crypt filter for reading or writing, validating encryption settings and versions.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts data bytes using the configured crypt filter and encryption method.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes using the configured crypt filter and encryption method.

methods.name: SetCryptFilterMethod
methods.description: Sets the crypt filter method (None, V2, AESV2, AESV3) for the filter.

methods.name: GetCryptFilterMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the current crypt filter method, parsing it from the dictionary elements.
